name: Clean Science
why: Management outlook: And I think going forward, we expect that the coming few quarters, we should touch between 55% to 60% capacity utilization.

guidance: And I think going forward, we expect that the coming few quarters, we should touch between 55% to 60% capacity utilization.

risks: That means we have retained EBITDA per kg despite all the headwinds and inflation.
So what Siddharth is al so trying to arrive this at is that during this quarter, the entire raw material cost increase on account of the inflationary pressure was not translated to the sales growth.
focus: Further, as we speak, we continue to add new customers and increase the wallet share from existing customers every quarter.

about: Incorporated in 2003, Clean Science and Technology Ltd is one of the leading chemical manufacturers globally. It manufactures functionally critical specialty chemicals such as Performance Chemicals (MEHQ, BHA, and AP), Pharmaceutical Intermediates (Guaiacol and DCC), and FMCG Chemicals (4-MAP and Anisole).
